title: Implementer guide updates: mention_broadcast rename + broadcast scopes
description:
Update jmap-chat-implementer-guide.md to track the main-draft permission rename in fig9.2 and the broader broadcast-mention feature.

Concrete changes needed:
- Line 314 references the old name 'mention_all'; rename to 'mention_broadcast' (main draft renamed in fig9.2)
- Wherever the guide describes the mention authorization model, update the description to cover broadcast scopes (`@everyone`, `@here`, `@admins`) not just per-user @mentions
- Add implementer guidance on the deployment-defined predicates for `@here` (which presence states qualify as 'active') and `@admins` (which permissions/roles qualify as administrative)
- Add implementer guidance on the Chat.muted bypass behavior for targeted broadcast mentions (deliberate UX, deployment-defined override mechanism)

This bead is non-normative (implementer guide). Out of scope for fig9.2 because fig9.2's description excludes guide updates; out of scope for fig9.5 because fig9.5 is the push-platform-guide, not the implementer-guide.

Blocked on fig9.2 (main draft must define the renamed permission and the BroadcastMention type first) — already implemented at the time this bead is created.
acceptance_criteria:
- 'mention_all' no longer appears in jmap-chat-implementer-guide.md
- Broadcast scopes covered in the mention-authorization narrative
- Predicate-definition guidance ('here'/'admins' deployment-defined)
- Chat.muted bypass implementer guidance present
- Non-normative tone preserved (no MUST/SHOULD/MAY upgrades)
close_reason: Renamed mention_all → mention_broadcast in §2 listing. Dropped 'fig9.2 pending' markers in §2.3 and §6.1, replaced with paragraphs reflecting the now-landed main-draft additions. Existing broadcast-mention coverage in §2.3 and §6.1 already satisfied all other acceptance criteria.
